note: This file contains only configuration constants (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines parameters for the Edinburgh pub coordination simulation in Google DeepMind's Concordia framework.
top_5_elements: VENUE_PREFERENCES - Dictionary mapping Edinburgh pub names to their descriptive attributes (atmosphere, drinks, food, vibe)
GAME_COUNTRIES - List of 19 Rugby World Cup participating countries used to generate match scenarios
SOCIAL_CONTEXTS - List of 5 Edinburgh-themed narrative context strings with {name} placeholder for agent social interactions
CALL_TO_DECISION - Template string 'To which pub would {name} go to watch the game?' driving agent decision-making
SCENARIO_PREMISE - Template string setting the simulation context: year, location, event, and group activity

example_statements.configure_edinburgh_simulation: set simulation parameters for an Edinburgh Rugby World Cup pub coordination scenario in Concordia
example_statements.define_venue_preferences: define Edinburgh pub attributes including atmosphere, drinks selection, and food offerings for agent decisions
example_statements.setup_social_contexts: create Edinburgh-themed social context narratives with location descriptions for agent interactions
example_statements.configure_game_countries: set the list of Rugby World Cup participating countries for match scheduling in the simulation
example_statements.set_decision_premise: define the call-to-decision template prompting agents to choose a pub for watching the game
